svg.title: Wall, Beekman Downtown Hospital
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. White paper margin remains part of support; yellow fill and narrow black lower band are visible. Pencil/brush texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=280; record guggenheim1996-cat-127; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
